mixing_rule: draw the same 256-row offline batch in B and C; in C replace the last cumulative 10 percent (25 or 26 rows) with oracle-episode rows, then apply the same seeded permutation
training_root_source: uniform episode draws from the established 5940-episode continuation partition; evaluation roots are never used
replay_retention: only the current refresh's 128 generated finite-horizon paths
generated_failure_initialization: alive at each observable offline root; historical hidden death is unavailable and unused
generated_absorption: fatal incoming motion retained; failure irreversible; XY frozen after failure; F4 shifts; task reward zero
final_checkpoint_selection: declared update budget only; all hashes sealed before native evaluation
native_primary_outcome: sum over t=0..49 of 0.95^t times native reward at t+1
native_reward_occurrence: any native reward, whose definition is physical next-XY distance to (8.5,3.5) below 2 and not dead
native_success: any native physical XY distance to (8.5,3.5) below 0.5; reported separately
